purpose: Record the current revised-law baseline before provision-level publication decisions.

sources.source: Registration of Title Act 1964 revised record
Registration of Deeds and Title Act 2006 revised record

verified_baseline: The Registration of Title Act 1964 commenced as a whole on 1 January 1967.

The current revised Act record identifies amendments and other effects, including amendments associated with the Registration of Deeds and Title Act 2006 and Land and Conveyancing Law Reform Act 2009.
The Registration of Deeds and Title Act 2006 has staged commencement dates and its current revised record records those commencement effects.
The 2006 Act amended sections 31, 32, 33, 84 and 85 of the 1964 Act, among other provisions.
Tailte Éireann currently maintains the Land Register, Registry of Deeds and Registry map and provides Landdirect access to Land Registry records.
current_law_rule: For publication, use the current revised statutory text together with its amendment and commencement tables; do not rely on the original enacted text alone.
historical_rule: Where a user's property event occurred in the past, resolve the law applicable on that date rather than automatically applying today's text.
remaining: Provision-level amendment and commencement matrix for each property-title proposition.
Full judicial review for each proposition.
Current form/rule mapping for each official-record route.
